text:
ajay: Quick heads-up — saw a regression on the rtx-a100 pool after last autotune. Triton path is slower for seqlen=256 in KV-prefill workloads.

maria: Can you paste the raw numbers?

ajay: Here are the microbench runs (batch=4, model=orca-13b):
```
seq=128  : triton  12.3 ms  | cutlass 13.8 ms
seq=256  : triton  28.9 ms  | cutlass 21.7 ms  <-- regression
seq=512  : triton  58.4 ms  | cutlass 42.2 ms
kv-prefill: enabled
probe_samples=50
```

kai: Interesting — kv-prefill will change memory layout / cache pressure. Triton kernels can spill earlier if the fused-attn kernel allocates more temp memory.

runtime-bot: [routing_decider] decision: model=orca-13b, batch=4, seqlen=256 -> prefer=triton (score=0.62), fallback=cutlass (score=0.38)

devex: Do we have recent kernel changes? I remember a fused-attn rewrite landed last week.

ajay: Yep, fused-attn v2 landed in the Triton branch. My hypothesis: v2 increases shared memory use which hurts >192 tokens with KV-prefill.

maria: Could be hysteresis too — the autotuner probe might be sticky after short probes. What does probe plan look like?

kai: Current probe config (from cluster):
```
routing.probe_plan = [
  { seqlen_range: [0,192], prefer: "triton" },
  { seqlen_range: [193,1024], prefer: "cutlass" }
]
routing.hysteresis_ms = 120
routing.probe_samples = 30
```

sophie: Probe_samples=30 is low for KV-prefill variance. We should run a dedicated probe with kv-prefill toggled off/on to isolate. Also capture p50/p95/p99, not just mean.

ajay: Agreed. Short list of experiments:
- probe with kv_prefill=false across seqlen sweep (64..1024)
- probe with kv_prefill=true but disable fused-attn v2 on Triton
- measure peak SLM and temp mem on Triton kernels

maria: Also consider adaptive routing by distribution rather than hard ranges. Heterogeneous loads mean a single seqlen cutoff is brittle.

kai: Proposed change to decider: add a memory-pressure factor and probe weight: 
`score = perf_pred * (1 - mem_pressure_weight) + fallback_penalty`
and increase probe_samples to 120 for initial warm-up.

runtime-bot: action logged: create job rt-probe-178512 for orca-13b (owner=@kai)

sophie: I'll run rt-probe-178512 now with both kv_prefill toggles and attach logs. Expect ~2 hours.

devex: For backout safety, add an automatic fallback rule: if triton latency > cutlass by 15% for 3 consecutive probes, route to cutlass for 10 minutes.

ajay: Good plan. Also add a trace hook to capture KV buffer sizes and allocation counts in the runtime trace.

maria: One more note — this only affects A100 pool. P4/P40 still prefer Triton aggressively. We should keep pool-specific probe states.

kai: I'll run the probes and post results. If fused-attn v2 is at fault we can revert and schedule a follow-up to optimize temp-memory footprint.

sophie: posted logs: https://internal-storage/runs/rt-probe-178512/logs (uploaded) :eyes:

ajay: Thanks — assigning perf-ticket #INF-482 to track.

maria: ack :thumbsup:
